BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah uses this word once, in a pair with desolation: fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction. It is ruin named plainly, with nothing softened.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prophet names ruin plainly because only a named ruin can be repented of, and desolation is not the end of the sentence God writes.
